tasks.description: Check if ports 5555 and 5556 are listening and save a health report to data/bus_health.txt
tasks.learned: /bin/sh -c 'for i in {5555,556}; do if [ \"$(nc --quiet localhost $i | awk '{print !$?}')\" = '' ]; then echo Port $(printf %.2d%${((++#))}) listening >> data/bus_health.txt; else ; done' &
tasks.title: Bus Health Check
